primary_concordance.comparison: Every cell decision, conformance, mismatch-key set, grouping and total; missing-value sentinel formatting is evaluator-specific

paired_case_total_wall_ratio.definition: Median of 108 ratios, each ratio dividing TETHER median of three import+operation timings by independent median for same case

footprint_scope: Pinned source inventory and complete installed Python inventories; package counts include archive/study modules outside this comparison
limitations: All cases are artificial, authored with access to repository and policy. No natural fault prevalence or scientific efficacy inference.
Repetitions are timing/replay observations, not additional independent cases; policy-family denominators overlap.
An integrity reconstruction does not prove that either implementation fulfills every clause outside tested controls.
Tracemalloc-instrumented timings include Python allocation instrumentation; fresh worker process startup is separate launcher wall time.
OS peak memory covers the worker lifetime, including imports; Python allocation peaks omit non-Python allocations.
Scratch bytes are a postrun retained-file inventory, not cumulative copy/write traffic or an execution-time peak.
Logical input inventory includes all bundled preparation/control files, not solely bytes consumed by the validator.
Actual logical read traffic and physical disk/cache behavior are unmeasured.
Local consistency hashes and pinned environment files are not a signed external attestation of execution or filesystem ownership.
Package bytes/lines are not a minimum equivalent implementation or measured development effort; paired endpoint is file validation, with runtime-only guarantees separately witnessed.
Oracle causal specificity and completeness remain separate reviews; no EP077 observable was repaired or removed.
Sums of per-process peak-memory readings are arithmetic fields only; they are not aggregate concurrent memory or peak physical demand.
